info.title: Cooper API
info.description: Cooper IT Service Management REST API (FR-API-001).

get.summary: Lists Analysts.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on name (and email or code where relevant).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one Company (Requesters and Cost Centres).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Only these records: UUIDs separated by commas, at most 200 (Requesters only).

post.summary: Reactivates an Analyst.

post.summary:

get.summary: Lists Email Templates (needs `tickets.configure`).

get.summary: Live Updates for the signed-in Analyst (Server-Sent Events, ADR-0022).
get.description:
Events: `ready` once changes are being received (refetch on every `ready` after the
first: changes may have been missed while disconnected); `invalidate` with
`{"topic":"ticket"|"ticket_presence","id":"…"}` when a ticket the Analyst may see
(or who has it open) changed; `resync`
when everything should be read again. Events never contain record data.

Needs the Analyst session cookie; API keys and Portal sessions are refused.

401.description: Not signed in with an Analyst session

get.summary: Lists Mailboxes with their health (needs `tickets.configure`).

post.summary:
Creates a Mailbox; `password` (IMAP) or `credentials` (Microsoft, Google) are stored
encrypted.

put.summary:
Replaces a Mailbox's settings; the stored secret is kept unless `password` or
`credentials` is given.

get.summary: Recent Rejected Emails of a Mailbox (Whitelist, unknown senders, loop protection).
Every Module and whether it is on (for navigation).

put.summary: Turns a Module on or off (needs `system.manage`).

get.summary: The signed-in Analyst's Notifications, newest first.

post.summary: Marks every Notification read.

get.summary: Number of unread Notifications (for the bell badge).

post.summary: Marks a Notification read.

Emails a one-time password reset link. Always answers `202`, whether or not the
account exists.

202.description: If the account exists, an email is on its way

post.summary: Sets a new password with the token from the email. Ends every session.

get.summary: The Portal Catalogue: portal-visible Categories in tree order.

401.description: Not signed in to the Portal

post.summary:
Sets a Portal password with the token from a Portal Invitation, reset or
Self-Registration email. Ends the account's other Portal sessions.

Emails a link to set a Portal password, if the address has an active Requester.
Always answers `202`.

202.description: If the address is known, an email is on its way

post.summary:
Self-Registration: emails a confirmation link to an address at a Company's Sender
Domain. Only when `portal.self_registration` is on.

202.description: A confirmation email is on its way

422.description: Not an address at a Company's Sender Domain

get.summary: The signed-in Requester, the Requesters the account can switch to, and the CSRF token.

post.summary: Signs a Requester in with email and password. Sets the `cooper_portal_session` cookie.

delete.summary: Signs out of the Portal and removes the cookie.

put.summary: Acts as another Requester with the same email address (another Company).

404.description: Not one of the account's Requesters

get.summary: What the Portal sign-in screen offers (Self-Registration on or off). Needs no session.

The Ticket Fields to ask on the new ticket form (FR-TKT-029). Send answers in
`fields` by key; fields marked `required_on_create` must be answered.

401.description: Not signed in to the Portal

get.summary: The signed-in Requester's tickets, newest first.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: `true` for open tickets, `false` for closed ones; both when absent.

401.description: Not signed in to the Portal

post.summary: Raises a ticket for the signed-in Requester.

401.description: Not signed in to the Portal

422.description: Not a Portal Catalogue entry, or invalid subject

get.summary: One of the Requester's tickets.
Attachments the Requester can see: their own uploads and files sent by email.

post.summary: Uploads a file (multipart field `file`) to one of the Requester's tickets.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment the Requester can see.

post.summary:
Replies on one of the Requester's tickets. Reopens a closed ticket and notifies the
Assignee, like an emailed reply.

get.summary:
The public timeline: public Notes and replies, oldest first. Internal Notes, time
and field history are never shown.
Lists active Reply Templates.

post.summary: Creates a Reply Template (needs `tickets.configure`).

put.summary: Replaces a Reply Template.

post.summary: Deactivates a Requester (timestamped).
Sends the Requester a Portal Invitation: a link to set a Portal password, valid 7 days.
Reactivates a Requester.

parameters.name: q

post.summary: Creates a Role.

get.summary: The signed-in Analyst, their permissions and the CSRF token.

post.summary: Signs in with username or email and password. Sets the `cooper_session` cookie.

delete.summary: Signs out and removes the session cookie.

put.summary: Changes the signed-in Analyst's password. Ends every session; sign in again.
Changes your email Signature.

delete.summary: Turns two-factor sign-in off (needs a current code; not allowed when required).

post.summary: Starts two-factor enrollment: returns a new secret to add to an authenticator app.
Confirms enrollment with a code; two-factor sign-in is on afterwards.

get.summary: Every System Setting (needs `system.manage`).

put.summary: Changes a System Setting (needs `system.manage`).

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still needed.

post.summary: Creates the default Company and the first Administrator (FR-SYS-004). Only works once.

get.summary: Lists SLA Calendars.

post.summary: Creates an SLA Calendar (needs `tickets.configure`).

put.summary: Replaces an SLA Calendar. Open tickets keep their computed due times.

get.summary: Lists SLA Notification Rules (needs `tickets.configure`).

get.summary: Warnings and errors from the server and worker, newest first (needs `system.view_log`).
Lists Teams.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on name (and email or code where relevant).

parameters.name: company_id

post.summary: Creates a Team.

get.summary: Loads a Team.

put.summary: Replaces a Team's name, description and active flag.
Replaces the Company access granted to a Team.
Replaces a Team's members.
Replaces the Roles assigned to a Team.

get.summary: Lists every Category (a tree: use `parent_id` and `depth`).

post.summary: Creates a Category under `parent_id` (at most 3 levels; needs `tickets.configure`).

put.summary: Changes a Category (its place in the tree stays).

get.summary: Every Ticket Field, active and retired (needs `tickets.read`).

post.summary: Defines a Ticket Field (needs `tickets.configure`).

put.summary: Changes a Ticket Field; key and type never change (needs `tickets.configure`).

post.summary: Undoes a merge (needs `tickets.merge`).

Undoes a split (needs `tickets.merge`); refused once the new ticket has activity of
its own.

get.summary: Ticket Type Rules in evaluation order (needs `tickets.configure`).

post.summary: Creates a Ticket Type Rule (needs `tickets.configure`).

put.summary: Changes a Ticket Type Rule (needs `tickets.configure`).

get.summary: Lists tickets: built-in views, filters, search, sorting and cursor paging.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search: Ticket Number prefix, subject, description and Notes.

post.summary: Creates a ticket (needs `tickets.create`; `tickets.assign` to set Queue or Assignee).

Applies one action to up to 100 tickets (FR-TKT-042). Each ticket is changed on its
own with the usual checks; the result lists the outcome per ticket.

get.summary: Finds a ticket by its Ticket Number.
Loads a ticket with its total time.

put.summary: Replaces a ticket's details (Queue, Assignee and status have their own endpoints).
Sets the Queue and Assignee (needs `tickets.assign`).

get.summary: Attachments of a ticket.

post.summary:
Uploads a file (multipart field `file`) as an attachment. The size limit is the
`attachments.max_size_mb` setting; the media type is detected from the content.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment (always as a download, never rendered inline).
Emails of a ticket, oldest first.
The Ticket Fields of a ticket with their values.

put.summary: Sets or clears Ticket Field values by key (needs `tickets.update`).

get.summary:
The links of a ticket, from its side (needs `tickets.read`). Links to tickets you may
not see are left out.

post.summary: Links the ticket to another ticket of the same Company (needs `tickets.update`).

delete.summary: Removes a link of the ticket (needs `tickets.update`).

post.summary:
Merges the ticket into another (needs `tickets.merge`). Its emails, Notes, Time
Entries and attachments move; it is closed as a duplicate, keeps its number and
points at the survivor (FR-TKT-026).

get.summary: The merges the ticket took part in, newest first.

post.summary: Adds a Note (internal unless `is_public`).

get.summary: The ticket's previous numbers, newest first (FR-TKT-003).
The other Analysts who have the ticket open now.

put.summary:
TicketPresence heartbeat: the signed-in Analyst has the ticket open (send every ~10 s).
Returns the other Analysts who do (FR-TKT-025).

delete.summary: The signed-in Analyst closed the ticket.

post.summary:
Gives the ticket a new number from the current format (needs `tickets.configure`).
The old number keeps finding the ticket (FR-TKT-003).
Sends a Reply to the Requester by email (SDREF subject, your Signature appended).

get.summary: A Reply Template filled in for a ticket.

post.summary: Restores a soft-deleted ticket (Administrators).

put.summary: Snoozes a ticket until a time.

post.summary:
Moves emails and Notes to a new ticket with the same details (needs
`tickets.merge`, FR-TKT-027).

Moves a ticket to another status. Closing needs a Resolution Code; closing and
reopening need `tickets.close`.

get.summary: Time Entries of a ticket.

post.summary: Records time on a ticket for the signed-in Analyst.

get.summary: The ticket's timeline: Notes, Time Entries and recorded changes, oldest first.

password.description: Initial password (create only; at least 12 characters).

prefix.description: Public prefix, to recognise the key (`cpr_<prefix>_…`).

ApiKeyRequest.description: Create or replace an API key.

media_type.description: Media type detected from the content.

BulkRequest.description: One action for many tickets (FR-TKT-042). Set `action` and the fields it uses.

target_ticket_id.description: The survivor (`merge`); it may also be among `ticket_ids`, and is then skipped.

BulkResultDto.description: The outcome for one ticket of a bulk action.

ok.description: Whether the action succeeded on it.

status.description: HTTP status the same change on its own would have returned.

CatalogueEntryDto.description: An entry of the Portal Catalogue.

type_ids.description: Limited to these Ticket Types (empty = all).

CompanyAccessDto.description: Company access of an Analyst or Team.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default Company.

CostCentreRequest.description: Create or replace a Cost Centre.

default_sensitivity.description: Default Sensitivity of its tickets: `normal` or `confidential`.

event.description:
Event it is sent on: `ticket_created` and `ticket_closed` (to the Requester),
`ticket_assigned` (to the new Assignee) or `ticket_replied` (an acknowledgement
when the Requester emails an update).

match_pattern.description:
Recipient address or domain this template is for; empty for everyone else. The
most specific template wins: address, then domain, then none.

subject.description: Subject with placeholders; the SDREF tag is added.

EmailTemplateEventDto.description: The ticket event an Email Template is sent on.

FieldValueDto.description: A Ticket Field with its value on a ticket.

FieldValuesRequest.description: Ticket Field values to set, by key; `null` clears a value.

IssuedApiKeyDto.description: A newly created API key. `key` is shown only in this response.

key.description: The full key. Store it now: it cannot be retrieved again.

last_duration_ms.description: Duration of the latest run in milliseconds.

JobRunDto.description: A run of a Background Job.

LinkedTicketDto.description: The ticket at the other end of a link.

request_id.description: HTTP request ID, to correlate with access logs.

LookupDto.description: A reference-data row (Ticket Status, Priority, Type, Origin or Resolution Code).

is_default.description: Status or Priority: default for new tickets.

key.description: Stable key of seeded rows (code relies on keys, not names).

sla_calendar_id.description: Priority: SLA Calendar (`null`: the default calendar).

LookupRequest.description:
Create or replace a reference-data row. Flags that do not apply to the kind are
ignored.

is_default.description: Status or Priority: default for new tickets.

sla_calendar_id.description: Priority: SLA Calendar (`null`: the default calendar).

MailboxDto.description:
A Mailbox. Secrets are write-only: send `password` (IMAP) or `credentials` (OAuth)
to set or replace them.

has_secret.description: Whether a secret is stored (responses only).

target_ticket_id.description: The survivor; must be open and in the same Company.

ModuleDto.description: A Module and whether it is on.

can_disable.description: Whether it can be turned off.

ModuleRequest.description: Turn a Module on or off.

PageDto_AnalystDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_ApiKeyDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

prefix.description: Public prefix, to recognise the key (`cpr_<prefix>_…`).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_CompanyDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default Company.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_CostCentreDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_DepartmentDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

default_sensitivity.description: Default Sensitivity of its tickets: `normal` or `confidential`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

items.description: A run of a Background Job.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

request_id.description: HTTP request ID, to correlate with access logs.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_RequesterDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_RoleDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PageDto_TeamDto.description: A page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page.

company_access.description: Company access granted to the Team.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PortalPasswordRequest.description: Set a Portal password with an emailed link.

email.description: Your email address at your Company.

PortalRequesterDto.description: A Requester the Portal Account can act as.

PortalResetRequest.description: Ask for a reset (or first) Portal password link.

expires_at.description: When the session ends regardless of activity.

idle_expires_at.description: When the session ends without activity.

requester.description: The Requester the session acts as.

requesters.description: Every Requester the account can act as (switch with `PUT /portal/session/requester`).

PortalSignInOptionsDto.description: What the Portal sign-in screen offers.

self_registration.description: Whether people at a Company's Sender Domain may register themselves.

PortalTicketDto.description: A ticket as the Requester sees it.

PortalTicketPage.description: A page of the Requester's tickets.

PortalTicketRequest.description: A ticket raised on the Portal.

category_id.description: A Portal Catalogue entry (required when the Catalogue is not empty).

fields.description:
Answers to the Ticket Fields the Portal asks (`GET /portal/ticket-fields`), by
key (FR-TKT-029).

PortalTimelineEntryDto.description: One public item on a ticket's Portal timeline.

from_requester.description: Whether the Requester side wrote it.

kind.description: `note` (a public Note from the service desk) or `message` (a reply).

composing.description: Whether the Analyst is writing a reply or Note.

text.description: The text with placeholders filled in.

number.description: The number; it still finds the ticket.

retired_at.description: When it stopped being the ticket's number.

all_companies.description: `true` when the Analyst sees every Company.

company_ids.description: The Companies the Analyst sees, when not all.

expires_at.description: When the session ends regardless of activity.

idle_expires_at.description: When the session ends without activity.

is_admin.description: Whether the Analyst is an Administrator (has every Capability).

totp_enrollment_required.description:
Two-factor sign-in is required but not set up: only `/session` endpoints work
until it is.

constraints.description: Bounds: `min`/`max` for integers, `max_chars` for text, `choices` for choices.

updated_at.description: When an Administrator last changed it.

value.description: The value; its type must match the setting's kind.

sender_domains.description: Sender Domains of the default Company.

ticket_code.description: Ticket Code of the default Company (1 to 10 letters or digits).

remember_device.description: Remember this browser for 30 days, so it skips the two-factor code.

totp_code.description:
Two-factor code from the authenticator app, when the Analyst uses two-factor
sign-in. Without it the response is `401` with type `totp-required`.

hours.description:
Working hours Monday to Sunday: seven entries, each `{start, end}` (`HH:MM`) or
`null` for a day off.

is_default.description: Used for Priorities without their own calendar.

paused_at.description: When the clock was paused, if it is.

responded_at.description: When the first response was recorded.

remaining_seconds.description:
Seconds until due (negative when overdue); absent when met, paused or without a
target.

until.description: Hidden from default views until then.

SplitRequest.description: Splits emails and Notes off a ticket.

subject.description: Subject of the new ticket (default: the same subject).

StatusRequest.description: Move a ticket to another status.

closure_category_id.description: Closure Category (required when closing, if configured).

SwitchRequesterRequest.description: Switch the Requester a Portal session acts as.

company_access.description: Company access granted to the Team.

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted (Administrators only see deleted tickets).

merged_into_id.description: The ticket this one was merged into (FR-TKT-026).

total_minutes.description: Total minutes of Time Entries (single-ticket responses only).

ask_requester.description: Asked of the Requester on the Portal.

required_on_close.description: Required before a ticket can be closed.

required_on_create.description: Required when a ticket is created by an Analyst or on the Portal.

type_ids.description: Ticket Types it applies to; empty for every type.

TicketLinkDto.description: A Ticket Link seen from one ticket (FR-TKT-028).

relation.description:
`related`, `duplicate_of`, `duplicated_by`, `parent_of` or `child_of`, from the
requested ticket's side.

TicketMergeDto.description: A merge of one ticket into another (FR-TKT-026).

id.description: ID (use it to undo the merge).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

fields.description:
Ticket Field values by key (create only; use `PUT /tickets/{id}/fields`
afterwards). FR-TKT-029.

team_id.description: Queue (create only; use the assignment endpoint afterwards).

id.description: ID (use it to undo the split).

oneOf.description: The new ticket (only right after splitting).

source_ticket_id.description: The ticket the rows came from.

TicketTypeRuleConditionsDto.description: Conditions of a Ticket Type Rule; empty lists are ignored.

requester_domains.description: Requester email domains; subdomains match too.

subject_keywords.description: Words or phrases; any one in the subject matches (ignoring case).

conditions.description: Conditions; all non-empty ones must match.

data.description: The Note, Time Entry or change (`{action, changes: [{field, old_value, new_value}]}`).

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

otpauth_uri.description: `otpauth://` URI to show as a QR code.

secret.description: The secret in base32, for manual entry into an authenticator app.

ViewerDto.description: Another Analyst who has the ticket open (FR-TKT-025).
